messages.text: Audio won't play in LT; is this QN or a player issue? I thought a workaround existed in the previous queue, but it is happening again. (task ref AUDIO-4294)
On task AUDIO-4294, please capture the LT error state and time; the wider cause is not confirmed here.
The waveform loads but pressing Play never starts sound. Could you note whether the waveform loads but the playhead stays at zero?
This affected task cannot be evaluated while the player fails to load. Report the playback incident with its task ID; do not mark the recording as a model-quality failure.
